notes.title: Patch 0.4.1
notes.notes:
Hello!
Release is certainly not very "rosy" but the main thing is to move forward.
Your feedback helps make the game better! :)
And you can expect some changes in the game:

- Changing the start of the game (Intro)
- Fixed bugs based on player reviews
- Increased weapon damage when hit in the head
- Reduced weapon reload time, now it is done faster by 30%
- Reduced recoil from weapons
- Reduced the cooldown of hook
- Increased brightness in some leves

And abouth "Stealth" mode - now the enemies notice you, much less.
